verdict.rationale: LobeChat/LobeHub ships built-in Agents that users can delegate to via natural language ('One sentence to start'), scheduled tasks, a dashboard showing what agents did while away, and auto team formation for complex work, all within the product itself rather than requiring external tools. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification (e.g. reviews confirming task delegation actually works end-to-end) beyond first-party marketing/docs copy.
